server_arguments.desc: Determines whether to trust and execute code from remote sources.
server_arguments.detailed_desc: Controls whether the system should trust and execute code loaded from remote sources. Enabling this can increase functionality by allowing dynamic updates and extensions, but it may pose security risks if the source is not secure. It is important to ensure that remote sources are reliable and secure before enabling this option.
